name: Multiplicative constraint substitution
description: Replaced the explicit 2x2 compatibility matrix (which instantly pattern-matches as the XOR/different-color rule of bipartite graphs) with a single multiplicative constraint ($c_u \times c_v = 2$) over the domain {1, 2}. This mathematically forces exactly the same assignments (one must be 1, one must be 2) but requires the model to deduce the differing-values requirement rather than reading it directly from a list of cases.
